review.reason: The stable TensorFlow 2.21.0 Windows/Linux package pair remains the active candidate, but the earlier upstream-lock selection of Keras 3.12.1 is no longer acceptable for a current execution set: current PyPI advisory metadata for exactly 3.12.1 reports multiple published vulnerabilities, including issues fixed in later Keras releases. TensorFlow 2.21.0 requires only keras >= 3.12.0, so the dependency selection is rebased to current stable Keras 3.15.1, which supports Python 3.11, preserves the same eight direct Keras dependency names, is Apache-2.0, and reports zero vulnerabilities in PyPI's point-in-time advisory field on 2026-09-23. This is not a claim that Keras 3.15.1 is vulnerability-free. Execution remains fail-closed because the complete transitive wheel/license/notice closure, security review of the remaining selected dependencies, and artifact-to-source build attestation are not yet complete. No package is installed or executed on this head.
